title: bomify plugin DeploymentResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<type> binary prints to stdout when its "deployment generate" succeeds, per plugins/contracts/deployment/v1/CONTRACT.md.

files.description: Every file the plugin wrote, "/"-separated, relative to --output. bomify checks they're exactly the regular files there.

instructions.description: What to do with the files, one short paragraph or command, run from --output, which bomify prints. Informational.
